description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory, responsible for creating and managing definition cache objects, including setup, registration, creation, and decoration of cache instances.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing definition cache objects, supporting setup, registration, creation, and decoration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes default decorators for the cache factory.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of the cache factory, optionally using a provided prototype.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new cache implementation with a short name and full class name.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cache object based on configuration and type, applying decorators.

methods.name: addDecorator
methods.description: Adds a decorator to all new cache objects, accepting either an instance or a decorator name.
